_about: Solo filter overrides (port of tools/lib/sim/solo.js OVERRIDES). exclude: quests to drop (category, reason; category null: excluded without a solo category); allow: quests kept whatever the rules say; turninAfter: parent -> quests turned in before it; startItemFrom: quest -> the quest whose turn-in hands over its starting item.

exclude.reason: Naxxramas-era Argent Dawn turn-ins at Light's Hope (patch 1.11 endgame materials)
Argent Dawn armaments: Scourge Invasion insignia and Friendly-Exalted ranks
Frostmaul Shards lie in the Frostmaul giants' cave (elite 59-60); opens the Mau'ari E'ko chain
the letter drops from Hive'Ashi elites; its non-elite droppers are hive-event spawns (3 recorded)
Concerted Efforts: one mark from each battleground
Eastern Plaguelands tower captures (world PvP objective)
corrupted plants: each needs a Cenarion Plant Salve (a Salve via ... turn-in item, not modelled)
Salve via ...: salve turn-ins (gathering or profession items), only for the corrupted plants
Smokey LaRue: crafted Thorium bars and bombs (profession items)
Midsummer Fire Festival: stealing the other faction's capital flames (seasonal; no event flag in the data)

allow.reason: Cooking rank 1 (Beer Basted Boar Ribs, Recipe of the Kaldorei): the starting-zone guides train Cooking at the trainer next to the giver
Unending Torment: its Blisterweed grows by the Undercity herbalism trainer (no object or drop in the data, so it would read as made inside the Ruins of Lordaeron area)
